name: TigerVespamon
main_effect:
[Hand] [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 [Royal Base] or [Zaxon] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash face up as the bottom security card, return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as this Digimon to the hand.
[All Turns] When this Digimon suspends, by flipping your top face-up security card face down, 1 of your Digimon unsuspends.
source_effect: Ace Overflow ＜-4＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
